# Rumi Byte

## Services

All services: https://rumibyte.com/services

### Branding & Identity (Design)

Page: https://rumibyte.com/services/branding-and-logo-design

Logos, color, type and brand guidelines so every touchpoint feels like the same company. Your brand is the first thing people judge. We build a complete visual identity that makes your business instantly recognisable, feel trustworthy, and look the same on every post, page and package.

Includes: Logo suite; Colour palette; Typography; Brand guidelines; Social media kit; Brand mockups.
Good for: New businesses, Rebrands, Personal brands, Startups.

### Graphic Design (Design)

Page: https://rumibyte.com/services/graphic-design

Social posts, ad creatives, flyers and marketing visuals made to stop the scroll. Eye-catching visuals for social media, ads and print. Every design is made to grab attention in the feed, communicate your message in seconds and stay true to your brand.

Includes: Social media posts; Ad creatives; Print design; Templates; Highlight covers; Brand consistency.
Good for: Small businesses, Online stores, Restaurants and cafes, Coaches and creators.

### UI/UX Design (Design)

Page: https://rumibyte.com/services/ui-ux-design

Wireframes, user flows and polished screens for websites and apps that are easy to use. Clear, beautiful screens for websites and apps, designed around how your customers think and what they need to do. We plan the experience first, then make it look stunning.

Includes: User flows; Wireframes; Visual design; Clickable prototype; Responsive layouts; Developer hand-off.
Good for: App ideas, Website redesigns, Startups, SaaS products.

## How we work

1. Brief & Goals: a free intro call to understand the business, goals, audience and scope.
2. Concept: research, moodboard, site structure and creative direction.
3. Design & Prototype: polished designs and clickable prototypes, refined with feedback.
4. Build: development, content, testing on all devices and a private preview link.
5. Launch & Grow: launch, tracking, results reports and ongoing improvements.

## Frequently asked questions

**What does Rumi Byte do?**
Rumi Byte is a remote design and technology studio. We create brand identities, graphic design, UI/UX design, websites, Shopify stores and AI automations, and we grow brands with Meta ads, TikTok ads, social media management, SEO, content writing and video editing.

**Do you work with international clients?**
Yes. We work remotely with businesses around the world, including the USA, the UK, Qatar, the UAE and Europe. We schedule calls around your time zone and communicate in clear, professional English.

**How much does a project cost?**
Prices start from $25 per reel and $99 for a design pack, logos from $199, websites from $599 and monthly marketing from $299. In Pakistan, prices start from PKR 3,000. Each service page shows its starting price, and you get a clear, fixed quote after a free intro call, with no hidden costs.

**How long does it take to build a website?**
It depends on the size of the project. A brand identity or a small business website usually takes a few weeks, and you receive a clear timeline in your project plan before we start.

**Can you redesign my existing website or brand?**
Yes. We can refresh your current logo and visuals, redesign your website for a modern, mobile-first experience, or rebuild it completely while keeping what already works.

**Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO-ready?**
Yes. Every website we build is responsive, fast and set up with on-page SEO basics such as clean structure, page titles, descriptions and structured data, so it is easier to find on Google and AI search tools.

**Do you offer support after launch?**
Yes. After launch we can manage your ads, social media, SEO and content, track results and send you easy-to-read reports, so your brand keeps growing.

**How do I get started?**
Send us a message on WhatsApp at +92 303 7957116 or email rumibyte@gmail.com with a few details about your business. We will book a free intro call and suggest the best next step.
